column1: 23313§telegraph§ˈtelɪgrɑːf§With the development of technology, telegraph as a means of communication has been gradually replaced by mobile phones, the Internet and other media means.§随着技术的进步，**电报**这种交流方式已经逐渐被手机、互联网和其他媒介所取代。§改例句：development 前缺冠词 the；mobile phone 改为复数 mobile phones，Internet 前补 the
23314§episodic§ˌepɪˈsɒdɪk§An episodic format is the writer's favourite, when he tries to relax by writing.§当这个作家想要用写作来放松自己时，他最爱用一种**松散**的形式来创作。§
23315§trespass§ˈtrespəs§Farmers have barricaded their fields to stop wild elephants from trespassing on the land in the south of Asia.§在南亚地区，农民在田地里设置障碍物来阻止野象**侵犯**他们的土地。§

23316§millennium§mɪˈleniəm§The Millennium Bug was really bothering the scientists in the 1990s, when the electronic technology hadn't been developed as fast as today.§20世纪90年代，电子技术的发展没有现在这样迅速，“**千年**虫”问题在当时确实困扰着科学家们。§改例句：Millennium Bug 前缺冠词 The；in 1990s 应为 in the 1990s；electron 应为形容词 electronic

23317§susceptible§səˈseptəbl§A large number of TV advertisements are aimed at susceptible young women who always buy goods they actually don't need.§大量的电视广告瞄准**易受影响**的年轻女性，她们总是购买一些实际上并不需要的东西。§改例句：A large number of 后接复数，advertisement 应为 advertisements

23318§antiseptic§ˌæntiˈseptɪk§In old times, the bodies of most of the emperors were dealt with antiseptic for lasting for ever.§在古代，为了死后长存，大多数皇帝的遗体都要做**防腐**处理。§改例句：most of 后接名词须带限定词，most of emperors 改为 most of the emperors
23319§indolent§ˈɪndələnt§Their indolent attitude was the cause of much unnecessary pain and suffering.§他们**懒惰**的态度是引起很多不必要的痛苦和折磨的原因。§
23320§thrifty§ˈθrɪfti§In ancient times, Chinese people were usually brought up to be thrifty and hard-working.§在古代，中国人在成长过程中常常受到勤俭**节约**的教育。§改例句：「在古代」应为 in ancient times，time 漏了 s

23321§nutritious§njuˈtrɪʃəs§In addition to a nutritious diet, a healthy body also depends on appropriate exercise.§除了**营养**的饮食之外，健康的身体还需要适当的运动。§改例句：In additional to 应为 In addition to；作「运动」讲的 exercise 不可数，去掉 an

23322§dupe§djuːp§Most historians reached the conclusion that the Indians were innocent dupes, blameless in the battle.§许多历史学家都得出这样的结论：印第安人是无辜的**受骗者**，他们无需担负这场战争的责任。§改例句：the Indian were 主谓不一致，Indian 应为复数 Indians
23323§overfill§ˌəʊvəˈfɪl§It's dangerous to overfill liquid storage tanks.§贮罐**过量充装**液体是危险的。§
23324§inviolable§ɪnˈvaɪələbl§What a man has experienced in the privacy must necessarily remain inviolable at any time.§一个人的隐私在任何时候都一定是**不可侵犯**的。§
23325§penalize§ˈpiːnəlaɪz§It's unfair that the whole medical staff should be penalized just because a nurse made a mistake.§仅仅因为一个护士犯错误，就**惩罚**所有的医务人员，这是不公平的。§
23326§slander§ˈslɑːndə(r)§Nowadays, it is not rare that stars sue the news agency for their slanders on their good reputation in the entertainment circle.§如今，在娱乐圈，明星指控新闻机构**诋毁**他们的名誉已屡见不鲜。§
23327§restore§rɪˈstɔː(r)§The government has been trying to restore public confidence in its management of the economy since the breakout of economic crisis.§自经济危机爆发以来，该政府就一直试图**重建**公众对其掌控经济能力的信心。§
23328§virtuous§ˈvɜːtʃuəs§Compared with intelligent people, virtuous and hard-working people will be more welcomed in the office.§与聪明的人相比，**品德高尚**、刻苦工作的员工在办公室更受欢迎。§
23329§superstitious§ˌsuːpəˈstɪʃəs§The majority of people don't believe in the old superstitious saying that the number 13 is unlucky.§大多数人都不相信“数字13不吉利”这一古老的**迷信**说法。§

23330§bead§biːd§Don't trifle with that string of purple beads which is worth more than five million dollars.§别小瞧了那串紫色的**珠子**，它价值高达500多万美元。§改例句：「小看」是 trifle with，漏了 with；value 不能这样作不及物动词，values more than 改为 is worth more than
23331§malt§mɔːlt§A bottle of 15-year-old malt whisky is taken out by the hostess to entertain her guests.§女主人拿出一瓶15年陈酿的**麦芽**威士忌招待客人。§
23332§augment§ɔːgˈment§Cities today are competing for the best talent that can augment the productivity of their economy.§今天的各个城市正在争夺可以**提高**经济生产率的最优秀人才。§

23333§agile§ˈædʒaɪl§Contrary to the traditional idea, many interviewers prefer candidates with agile minds to those with high marks at universities.§与传统观点相反，许多面试官更喜欢思维**敏捷**的求职者，而不是那些在大学取得高分的人。§改例句：「与…相反」是 contrary to，on the contrary to 用错，idea 前补 the；candidates 是复数，mind 改为 minds
23334§tribal§ˈtraɪbl§At the first sight of tribal arts and dress on the island, tourists will certainly be attracted.§当游客第一眼看到岛上的**部落**艺术和服饰时，就一定会被其吸引。§

23335§precede§prɪˈsiːd§If people were to precede the comprehensive notion of environmental protection, species would not face the situation of becoming extinct any more.§如果人类**早些**对环境保护有一个全面的概念，就不会有更多物种面临灭绝的危险了。§
23336§alleviate§əˈliːvieɪt§An injection did little to alleviate Jane's pain after operation.§注射药物并没有**缓解**简手术后的疼痛。§

23337§antibiotic§ˌæntibaɪˈɒtɪk§Although an antibiotic can be used against infection, doctors won't persuade their patients to take it for a long time.§虽然**抗菌素**可以用来防止感染，但医生并不建议病人长期服用。§改例句：单数可数名词 antibiotic 前缺冠词，补 an

23338§overexploit§ˌəʊvərɪksˈplɔɪt§Many valuable natural resources, like coal and oil, are on the verge of exhaustion because people are overexploiting them.§由于人们**过度开采**，像煤和石油之类宝贵的自然资源正濒临枯竭。§改例句：「濒临」是 on the verge of，in 用错
23339§grill§grɪl§Our leader grilled us about why we were absent from the evening party after the meeting.§我们领导**盘问**我们为什么缺席会议之后的晚会。§改例句：evening party、meeting 前缺冠词 the
23340§inculcate§ˈɪnkʌlkeɪt§Chinese parents try to inculcate a sense of social responsibility in their children when they are still young.§中国的父母在孩子很小的时候就试图向他们**灌输**一种社会责任感。§
23341§brutal§ˈbruːtl§It was not the first time to report the brutal treatment towards prisoners by the troops.§这已经不是第一次报道军队**虐**待战俘的情况了。§
23342§avenge§əˈvendʒ§Study shows that some people are likely to avenge society once they are treated unequally.§研究发现，一些人一旦受到不公平的待遇，就很可能**报复**社会。§
23343§invasive§ɪnˈveɪsɪv§Ecologists are concerned that the invasive species has spread rapidly through local rivers, threatening native fish and plants.§生态学家担心这种**入侵**物种已在当地河流中迅速蔓延，威胁着本地的鱼类和植物。§补例句

23344§upgrade§ˌʌpˈɡreɪd§With the increase in terrorist attacks, more and more international airports plan to upgrade the safety check systems.§随着恐怖主义袭击的增加，越来越多的国际机场计划**升级**安检系统。§改例句：「恐怖袭击」是 terrorist attacks，terrorism 用错

23345§commute§kəˈmjuːt§Eventually, it is predicted that many people may be able to work at home instead of commuting to the office in the future.§据预测，在未来许多人最终可以在家办公，而不用乘公交**往返上下班**。§改例句：commuting at office 介词错且缺冠词，改为 commuting to the office

23346§legislative§ˈledʒɪslətɪv§The United Nations has taken new legislative measures to stem the flow of weapons into the developing countries.§联合国已采取新的**立法**措施来阻止武器流入发展中国家。§改译文：原译「法律」不是 legislative（立法的）的意思，改为「立法」
23347§differentiate§ˌdɪfəˈrenʃieɪt§The main aim of the management course is to teach us how to differentiate primary work from secondary work in the office.§该管理课程的主要目的是教我们如何**区分**首要工作和次要工作。§
23348§sentient§ˈsentiənt§Because animals are living and sentient beings, they deserve special protection and respect.§动物是活生生、**有知觉**的生物，它们应该受到特殊的保护和尊重。§
23349§pour§pɔː(r)§Old customers pour out of the shopping centres cheering wildly at the weekends.§周末，老顾客欢欣雀跃地从购物中心**蜂拥**而出。§
23350§hook§hʊk§Paul hooked his tractor to the car and pulled it to safety.§保罗把他的拖拉机**挂**在那辆小汽车上，然后把它拖到安全的地方。§
23351§tighten§ˈtaɪtn§During that special period, everyone must tighten their belt as a result of national income and foreign trade stagnation.§在那段特殊时期，由于国内收益和国外贸易的停滞，每个人都要**勒紧**腰带过日子。§

23352§humane§hjuːˈmeɪn§A series of campaigns for the humane treatment of wildlife has been launched throughout the world in recent years.§近年来，全世界发起了一连串的宣传**善**待野生生物的活动。§改例句：A series of 后接复数，campaign 应为 campaigns

23353§infiltrate§ˈɪnfɪltreɪt§Many companies want their new employees to quickly adapt themselves to working environment and infiltrate corporate culture.§许多公司希望新员工很快适应工作环境并**融入**企业文化。§改译文：原译文末多出排版残留「者）」，删去
23354§violate§ˈvaɪəleɪt§The legislative should take measures to prevent the mass media from violating the public's privacy.§立法机构应该采取措施制止大众媒体**侵犯**人们的隐私。§

23355§glacier§ˈɡlæsiə(r)§Glacier Bay, located in southeast Alaska, United States, is a narrow inlet of the Pacific Ocean which runs from northwest to southeast for about 105 kilometers.§**冰川**湾，位于美国阿拉斯加东南部，是太平洋的一个狭窄入海口，它自西北流向东南，全长约105公里。§
23356§hereditary§həˈredɪtri§Albinism is a hereditary disease, which can be visible when the recessive gene does work.§白化病是一种**遗传性**疾病，当隐性基因表现出来时就会发病，显示症状。§改例句：「显现出来」是 visible，visual（视觉的）用词错
23357§insidious§ɪnˈsɪdiəs§Hypertension is usually an insidious disease which has few symptoms in the early stage.§高血压通常是一种**潜伏性**疾病，早期几乎没有症状。§
23358§discharge§ˈdɪstʃɑːdʒ§Thousands of marine organisms were murdered as a result of a discharge of toxic wastes from a nearby chemical factory.§附近一个化工厂**排出**的有毒废料造成数以千计海洋生物的死亡。§

23359§refrain§rɪˈfreɪn§The survey finds that the majority of people can refrain from smoking in public places such as theaters and museums.§调查发现，在剧院和博物馆这类公共场所大多数人能够**克制**住不抽烟。§改例句：举例的可数名词单数不能直接用，theater and museum 改为复数 theaters and museums
23360§supportive§səˈpɔːtɪv§Children can often do better at school for they have supportive parents.§有父母的**支持**，孩子们在学校常常会表现得更好。§

23361§accustom§əˈkʌstəm§If you go abroad for further study, it will take a period of time for you to accustom yourself to the new environment, the new culture and all the new rules and regulations.§如果你出国留学，那么你需要花上一些时间让自己**习惯**新的环境、新的文化和所有新的规则与制度。§
23362§inalienable§ɪnˈeɪliənəbl§From my point of view, childbirth is the inalienable right of female employees who work in private companies.§在我看来，生孩子是在私企工作的女性员工**不可剥夺**的权利。§
23363§savour§ˈseɪvə(r)§Every day, people should afford a short moment to savour the gain and loss of the whole day before going to bed.§每天，人们都应该在睡觉前抽出片刻来**品味**一天的得与失。§

23364§pump§pʌmp§The villagers were tired of getting water from several miles away, so they invented a machine for pumping groundwater.§村民们厌倦了到几英里之外的地方打水，于是他们发明了一种可以**抽**地下水的机器。§改例句：machine 以辅音开头，an 应为 a
23365§astronomy§əˈstrɒnəmi§Astronomy is an extensive science, which can connect with physics, optics and astrology.§**天文学**是一门涉及广泛的科学，可以与物理学、光学和占星学相关联。§
23366§hazardous§ˈhæzədəs§The acid rain in big cities can be hazardous to the environment where people live and their health.§大城市中的酸雨会**危害**人们生活的环境以及他们的健康。§

23367§segregate§ˈsegrɪgeɪt§It is necessary to segregate two groups of fans in the stadium, in case of unnecessary fights after the game.§为了避免赛后不必要的争斗，将体育场的两部分球迷**隔开**是非常必要的。§改例句：fight 是可数名词，单数不能直接用，改为复数 fights
23368§tillable§ˈtɪləbl§Scientists have found that tillable lands have declined sharply in recent years due to global warming.§科学家发现，近年来由于全球变暖，**可耕种**土地骤减。§

23369§overgraze§ˌəʊvəˈɡreɪz§Once the grassland is overgrazed, the vegetation will be damaged and the ground will become liable to erosion.§一旦草地遭到**过度放牧**，就会导致植被受损，土壤易于流失。§改例句：「草地」是一个词 grassland，grass land 拼写错
23370§embody§ɪmˈbɒdi§As a rule, if you want to write a good essay, you'd better list some relevant examples embodying the gist.§通常，如果你想写出好文章，你最好列举一些**体现**文章主旨的相关例子。§
23371§reciprocate§rɪˈsɪprəkeɪt§Generally speaking, people will reciprocate the kindness that has been shown to them before.§一般而言，人们会**回报**之前受到的恩惠。§改例句：先行词 kindness 是单数，have 应为 has
23372§moribund§ˈmɒrɪbʌnd§There is a big problem for that country at present that how the economy can be revived from its present moribund state.§该国眼下的一个大难题是经济如何从**濒临崩溃**的状态中走向复苏。§

23373§isolated§ˈaɪsəleɪtɪd§Old people could easily become a socially isolated group, so they should keep moving and maintain interaction with the outside world.§老年人很容易变成与社会**脱节**的一个群体，所以他们应该不断前进并保持与外界的互动。§
23374§modish§ˈməʊdɪʃ§Nowadays, there is an interesting phenomenon that some bygone fashions, such as mini-skirt, become modish again.§如今，一个有趣的现象是一些过去的时尚再度**流行**开来，如迷你裙。§
23375§maltreat§ˌmælˈtriːt§It is necessary for the government to make relevant laws to punish people who maltreat domestic animals.§政府有必要制定相关法律来惩罚**虐待**家养动物的人。§
23376§disobey§ˌdɪsəˈbeɪ§To question or disobey the law is tantamount to destroying the authority of the law.§质疑或**违抗**法律，等同于摧毁法律的权威。§
23377§versatile§ˈvɜːsətaɪl§Because honey is versatile and not expensive, it is widely used in every aspect of our daily life.§蜂蜜具有**多种功能**且价格不贵，因此被广泛应用于日常生活的各个方面。§
23378§grudge§grʌdʒ§Owing a grudge against somebody or something consumes one's energies and finally accomplishes nothing at all.§对某个人或某件事记**仇**会耗费一个人的精力，到最后一无所获。§
23379§pretentious§prɪˈtenʃəs§The writer wrote a book review in pretentious language to express his biased criticism.§该作者写了一篇书评，言语间满是**自负**，表达了相当偏执的评论意见。§改例句：「写书评」应为 wrote a book review，took 用词错
23380§enlist§ɪnˈlɪst§At present, tens of thousands of volunteers are being enlisted all over the country to serve the approaching Winter Olympics.§目前，正在全国范围内**招募**成千上万的志愿者，为即将到来的冬奥会服务。§
23381§curb§kɜːb§The effective measure to curb the spread of the virus is keeping the computer off.§**控制**病毒传播最有效的方法就是不开电脑。§

23382§elaboration§ɪˌlæbəˈreɪʃn§After the homework has been discussed, the teacher explains the topic of the lesson, slowly and with a lot of repetition and elaboration.§讨论完作业之后，教师会缓慢地、反复**精细**地讲解这节课的主题。§
23383§snobbish§ˈsnɒbɪʃ§In current society, some people are very snobbish, who'd like to make friends only with people of wealth and of high social status.§在当今社会，有些人非常**势利**，他们只愿意与有钱和社会地位高的人交朋友。§
23384§magnet§ˈmægnət§Paris has always played a role of a magnet to attract people to seek romance and true love.§巴黎一直扮演着一个**磁铁**一样的角色，不断吸引着想要寻找浪漫和真爱的人们。§
23385§prevalence§ˈprevələns§The illness on neck, which used to bother the elderly, is of prevalence among young office workers nowadays.§过去常常烦扰老年人的颈椎病现在**盛行**于年轻的上班族之中。§
23386§bleak§bliːk§The future looks bleak for the fishing industry.§渔业前景**暗淡**。§
23387§ecliptic§ɪˈklɪptɪk§There is an angle between the ecliptic plane and the equatorial plane which is called the obliquity of the ecliptic.§**黄道**面与赤道面之间有一个夹角被称为黄赤交角。§
23388§vicious§ˈvɪʃəs§A group of tourists suffered a vicious attack by a gang of local people.§一群旅游者遭到一帮当地流氓的**恶意**攻击。§
23389§begrudge§bɪˈgrʌdʒ§The rich, who saw their income slashed, did begrudge sharing their gains with the poor.§那些发现自己的收入大幅减少的富人对与穷人分享收益表示**不满**。§
23390§diffuse§dɪˈfjuːz§Nowadays, the Internet has become a powerful means of diffusing knowledge and information instead of television.§如今，互联网已取代电视成为**传播**知识和信息的有力媒介。§改例句：Internet 前缺冠词 the
